description: Get the latest feedback across the whole team or one folder's subtree (team names the team), newest first: text and recording comments on every asset you can view, so you can read feedback across many videos in one call. Each item has a `type` field ("text" or "recording"), author, timestamp, a link that opens the comment, the asset it belongs to (container_id / container_title) and the version it was left on (asset_id = version id, version number). Scope with folder_id to read one client's/project's feedback, narrow the window with since/until, and page with offset = the previous next_offset: next_offset is set while more remain, and a page can hold fewer than limit items. For one asset's feedback (open items by default) use feedback_list; to wait for new feedback, wait_for_feedback; for counts and trends, feedback_stats.

folder_id.description: Only feedback on assets inside this folder's subtree

limit.description: Number of comments to return (default 20, max 100)

offset.description: Items to skip for pagination (use next_offset from the previous response)

since.description: Only feedback created at/after this ISO timestamp

team_id.description: Team to act in: the team.id an earlier result named. Omit for the team selected in the Flask app (which the user can switch at any time).

until.description: Only feedback created at/before this ISO timestamp

name: recent_activity
title: Get recent team feedback
